name: The Lattice Grimoire
source:
A curse wove their fates together: Blake, the mysterious musician; Ryan, the angry outsider; and Grayson, the babbling bookworm.
Now their thoughts and feelings influence Verity and her actions determine their fates. Will she be able to break the curse? Or will their dark pasts drag her into an inescapable despair? And can a fresh start really erase the past?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099660/The_Lattice_Grimoire/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个诅咒将他们的命运编织在一起：布莱克，神秘的音乐家；布莱克，神秘的音乐家；瑞安，愤怒的局外人；还有格雷森，那个喋喋不休的书呆子。
现在，他们的思想和感情影响着惟真，而她的行为决定了他们的命运。她能打破诅咒吗？还是他们的黑暗过去会让她陷入无法逃避的绝望？重新开始真的能抹去过去吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099660/The_Lattice_Grimoire/]Steam[/url]]
